name: trellis-upgrade
title: Upgrade vendored Trellis 0.6.7 to 0.6.14
description: Upgrade the vendored Trellis surface from 0.6.7 to 0.6.14 via the official trellis update mechanism (not a scripts-only file swap: the pack hash-tracks 114 Trellis template files across five platform directories). Verified safe: .trellis/scripts is byte-identical to the 0.6.7 release templates and 111/114 tracked files are unmodified; the two managed-block files merge safely. Delivers the task.py create base-branch seed fix observed live during the 2026-08-08 consolidation, upstream hook UTF-8 stdin fixes (statusline itself is opt-in, excluded from trellis update, and not installed here), journal merge=union, and task.py --json output adopted by sd-ai-command-pack-status.py (the only prose-parsing wrapper).
